name: Badge
description: A count or a dot on a block's corner: unread messages on an icon, a status on an avatar.

content.description: A number is drawn in the page's digits, past max as max and a plus; words as given; unset, a dot.

label.description: What it says to a screen reader: «۳ پیام تازه».

placement.description: Its corner; start and end follow the page's direction.

children.description: What it sits on: one block.
